## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

No single symbol carries this — nine independent ViewModels, none
related to another, each missing the same mechanism. Listed together
because the gap names them together; each is its own bearer and
follows from none of the others:

- `RaceDetailViewModel` — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/racedetail/RaceDetailViewModel.kt
- `ProfileViewModel` — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/profile/ProfileViewModel.kt
- `ImportPreviewViewModel` — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/importpreview/ImportPreviewViewModel.kt
- `PasteErrorViewModel` — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/pasteerror/PasteErrorViewModel.kt
- `PasteResultViewModel` — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/pasteresult/PasteResultViewModel.kt
- `MainRacePageViewModel` — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/race/MainRacePageViewModel.kt
- `ProjectionViewModel` — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/projection/ProjectionViewModel.kt
- `ControlViewModel` — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/control/ControlViewModel.kt
- `PreparationViewModel` — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/preparation/PreparationViewModel.kt

## Trigger

A configuration change (rotation) — nothing observes it. None of the
nine constructors takes a `SavedStateHandle`; nothing in either module
does (`Grep "SavedStateHandle"` returns no file in `app-phone` or
`app-wear`). Each `*ViewModel` keeps its state in a plain `private
var`/`MutableStateFlow` backed by no saved-state mechanism, so a
configuration change that does not retain the `ViewModelStore` loses
it.

## Today

- **`RaceDetailViewModel`** (`racedetail/RaceDetailViewModel.kt`):
  `dialogState` (`renameFieldValue`, `isDeleteConfirmVisible`) and
  `lastKnownRace` are plain fields, never written to a
  `SavedStateHandle`.
- **`ProfileViewModel`** (`profile/ProfileViewModel.kt`):
  `latestProfile`, `isConnectivityDenied`, `syncState`,
  `hrMaxRejectionMessage`, `distanceRejectionMessage`,
  `pressDurationRejectionMessage` and
  `zoneThresholdRejectionMessages` are plain fields.
- **`ImportPreviewViewModel`** (`importpreview/ImportPreviewViewModel.kt`):
  its whole `uiState` is built once, in the property initialiser, from
  the `@Assisted success: HyresultParseResult.Success` constructor
  parameter. `HyresultParseResult.Success` is a plain
  `:core-domain` data class (`core-domain/src/main/kotlin/.../HyresultResultParser.kt`),
  not `Parcelable` — `:core-domain` never imports Android
  (`TECHNICAL_CONVENTIONS.md` §3). Nothing here is written down before
  `onSaveClicked` persists the race.
- **`PasteErrorViewModel`** (`pasteerror/PasteErrorViewModel.kt`):
  same shape — `uiState` is built once from `@Assisted failure:
  HyresultParseResult.Failure`, itself a plain, non-`Parcelable`
  `:core-domain` data class.
- **`PasteResultViewModel`** (`pasteresult/PasteResultViewModel.kt`):
  `pastedText`, `raceName`, `raceDate` and `lastParseResult` live only
  in `mutableUiState`, itself a plain `MutableStateFlow` with no saved
  backing. Nothing is written down before `onImportClicked` parses and
  hands off.
- **`MainRacePageViewModel`** (`race/MainRacePageViewModel.kt`):
  `heldRace`, `lastKnownNow`, `lastHrBpm`, `lastHrAt`, `activeZone`,
  `lastCumulativeDistanceM`, `lastDistanceAt` and `baselineDistanceM`
  are plain fields, built from `@Assisted initialRace: Race` and
  updated only by sensor callbacks.
- **`ProjectionViewModel`** (`projection/ProjectionViewModel.kt`):
  `heldRace`, `lastKnownNow` and `currentLapDelta` are plain fields.
- **`ControlViewModel`** (`control/ControlViewModel.kt`): `heldRace`
  and `stopConfirmVisible` are plain fields.
- **`PreparationViewModel`** (`preparation/PreparationViewModel.kt`):
  `referenceRace` and `opened` are plain fields;
  `heartRateText` is transient, sensor-derived.

## Expected

Each of the nine `*ViewModel`s takes a `SavedStateHandle` in its
constructor and writes to it the fields among its own that must
outlive a configuration change; the rest stay plain properties.

Two things the fix cannot avoid, beyond adding the parameter:

- **`ImportPreviewViewModel` and `PasteErrorViewModel`** are built
  from an `@Assisted` value (`HyresultParseResult.Success` /
  `.Failure`) that is itself not `Parcelable` and, by the module
  split, cannot become one (`:core-domain` never imports Android). A
  `SavedStateHandle` cannot hold that value directly — the fix has to
  save the primitives it is built from (or re-derive the value some
  other way) rather than the assisted parameter itself.
- **`MainRacePageViewModel`, `ProjectionViewModel` and
  `ControlViewModel`** are built from `@Assisted` `Race` /
  `Profile` values, similarly plain `:core-domain` classes. §11 of
  `TECHNICAL_CONVENTIONS.md` already states the ViewModel is not the
  source of truth for a race in progress — the database is — so what
  the fix likely retains here is the identifying value (a race id),
  re-read from the repository, not the `Race` object itself. This is
  named because it constrains the fix; the exact field is a
  downstream decision, not confirmed further here.
